collection.title: Iveco Daily 1999 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Iveco Daily 1999 - 2006 requires 24" wiper blades for both drivers side and passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
